opciones: Running the query on two different LLMs
Combining keyword (sparse) and vector (dense) retrieval and merging their scores
Searching images and text at the same time
Caching the results of previous queries
preguntas.explicacion: Hybrid search fuses lexical matches (e.g. BM25) with semantic vector matches, so each covers the other's blind spots.

preguntas.enunciado: When does dense (vector) retrieval beat plain keyword search?
opciones: When the query and document share exact terms
When they mean the same thing using different words
preguntas.explicacion: Vector retrieval matches meaning, so it finds paraphrases and synonyms that exact-term keyword search would miss.
